name: Accessible name of the label panel and of its category menu: the category an admin or the model gives a failure.
load-failed: Error in the label panel of a failure when its label could not be read.
save-failed: Error when an admin's label for a failure could not be saved.
saved: Toast after an admin saves a label.
subject: What the rules said about a failed turn. {{category}} is one of category.* (or –); <code> wraps {{rule}}, the rule's internal name; keep it as is. The _tool form starts with {{tool}}, a tool's name; _tool-call with a tool call whose name wasn't recorded.
input: Label over the error text the model reads to suggest a category.
no-input: In place of the error text the model reads, when the failure recorded none.
suggests: {{category}} is one of category.*; {{confidence}} how sure the model is. The base form: its suggestion was applied. The _only form: it wasn't.
in-force: The label that counts now. {{category}} is one of category.*; {{name}} the admin's name; {{when}} a date and time. The _an-admin form: the admin's name is unknown; _model: the model labeled it.
save: Button: saves the category the admin chose as the failure's label.
counts: Beside Save label: it counts within a minute, and joins the "golden set" (the admin-labeled examples the model is evaluated against).
rules-only: Shown when a failure can't be labeled: the rules already sorted it.
